content: Toronto East General Hospital, located in Toronto, Ontario, within the former borough of East York, operates as a teaching hospital. The facility is equipped with 382 acute care beds, 13 rehabilitation beds, and 75 complex continuing care beds. During the 2006/07 period, the hospital managed over 60,000 emergency room visits and admitted more than 19,000 in-patients. Additionally, approximately 3,500 babies were delivered at the hospital's Maternal Newborn and Child Health Centre. This centre specializes in Level II Maternity and Neonatal Care and serves as a regional pediatric hub within the Child Health Network of Toronto. The hospital's Chief of Staff is Dr. Alfio Meschino, while its President and CEO is Rob Devitt.
